prompt: The camera does not move. Pure chaos: the two masked figures nearest the lens rip fat wads of paper in half again and again and fling the shreds straight at the camera, lunging toward it; above them the two hanging off the top racks swing and kick, tearing files loose so sheets cascade down, and the one behind hauls himself up the shelving. Paper fills the air under the flickering tubes. All five keep their masked faces turned toward the lens throughout, white rings and little red triangles clearly visible. Frantic, joyful, shot at 24fps with a 180-degree shutter so hands and flying paper blur. The camera does not move.
